scripts.test:web: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.verify:auth-env: [ -n "${DUEBLY_KINDE_CLIENT_ID:-${VITE_KINDE_CLIENT_ID:-}}" ] && [ -n "${DUEBLY_KINDE_REDIRECT_URI:-${VITE_KINDE_REDIRECT_URI:-}}" ] && [ -n "${DUEBLY_KINDE_LOGOUT_URI:-${VITE_KINDE_LOGOUT_URI:-}}" ] || { echo 'Missing required auth env vars for build: DUEBLY_KINDE_CLIENT_ID, DUEBLY_KINDE_REDIRECT_URI, DUEBLY_KINDE_LOGOUT_URI (or VITE_* equivalents)'; exit 1; }
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build && npx wrangler@4.15.2 deploy --config ../wrangler.toml --env dev --assets ./dist
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run verify:auth-env && DUEBLY_KINDE_AUDIENCE=${DUEBLY_KINDE_AUDIENCE:-https://api.duebly.app} npm run build && npx wrangler@4.15.2 deploy --config ../wrangler.toml --assets ./dist
